meta.name: looker_ingest
meta.description: Extract durable ktx knowledge and semantic-layer contribution proposals from staged Looker runtime dashboard, Look, and explore JSON. Load for WorkUnits whose raw files are under explores/, dashboards/, or looks/.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 Looker 运行时提取知识并生成语义层提案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常从 Looker 仪表板提取元数据用于数据治理
copy.tagline_en: Extract knowledge from Looker runtime and generate semantic layer proposals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often extract metadata from Looker dashboards for data governance

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能从 Looker 仪表板、Look 和探索中提取可复用的指标、维度定义和业务语义，并写入知识库。
howto.when: 当处理包含 explores/、dashboards/ 或 looks/ 下原始文件的 WorkUnit 时触发。

say.text: 请从这份 Looker 探索 JSON 中提取指标和维度。
say.note: Claude 会解析 JSON 并生成知识候选。

say.text: 分析这个 Looker 仪表板，找出可复用的业务概念。
say.note: Claude 会提取定义并写入知识库。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude extracts reusable metrics, dimension definitions, and business semantics from Looker dashboards, Looks, and explores, and writes them into knowledge memory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when processing WorkUnits with raw files under explores/, dashboards/, or looks/.

say_en.text: Extract metrics and dimensions from this Looker explore JSON.
say_en.note: Claude parses the JSON and generates knowledge candidates.

say_en.text: Analyze this Looker dashboard for reusable business concepts.
say_en.note: Claude extracts definitions and writes to knowledge.
